rules.lateness: Reservation rate with the lowest mean late days over the development normal and shock runs, then mean % late, then the rate closest to 1 (one day of scarce capacity costs one day of lateness).
rules.hybrid: Among lateness-first configurations whose development % late (normal and shock) is within 0.25 points of the lateness preset and whose late days are no higher, the lowest development expected % def pcs, then % late, then name. The lateness preset wins if none qualifies.
rules.defects: Among configurations whose development % late is at most 0.85 x random's (normal and shock), the lowest development expected % def pcs, then % late, then name.
rules.fairness: Among configurations within 1.0 point of the lateness preset's development % late, the lowest development max share, then % late, then name.
rules.robustness: The lowest development shock-minus-normal change in % late, then in late days, then the smaller weight. The lateness preset (weight 0) is a candidate, so 'no change' can win.
